test_selection_bad_columns: test the groupby column selection raises KeyError when referencing columns not found in the dataframe
test_duplicated_column_error: test that groupby raises ValueError when grouping by a duplicated column name
test_column_select_via_attribute: test selecting a single column via attribute access returns the same result as bracket notation in groupby
test_getitem_list_of_columns: test groupby with a list of column names returns the expected aggregated dataframe
test_getitem_single_column: test groupby selecting a single column returns a Series instead of a DataFrame
test_grouper_index_types: test groupby works correctly with various index types including DatetimeIndex and PeriodIndex
test_grouper_multilevel_freq: test groupby with Grouper objects specifying level and freq on MultiIndex columns
test_grouper_creation_with_key: test creating a Grouper with the key parameter produces equivalent results to string-based groupby
test_grouper_with_column_and_index: test grouping by both a column and a MultiIndex level produces equivalent results to reset_index then groupby
test_groupby_dict_mapping: test groupby with a dictionary mapping produces equivalent results to groupby with the mapped values
test_groupby_grouper_f_sanity: test that a groupby lambda function operates on individual index values not the whole index
test_groupby_with_datetime_key: test groupby with a Grouper specifying freq on a datetime column bins correctly
test_groupby_multiindex_partial_indexing: test partial column selection on MultiIndex columns returns equivalent results across aggregation methods
test_groupby_level_with_nas: test groupby on MultiIndex levels with NaN values handles factorization correctly
test_groupby_empty_dataframe: test groupby on an empty Series returns expected empty result with correct index
test_get_group_with_datetime: test get_group retrieves correct rows when grouping by datetime column with various key formats
test_get_group_by_tuple: test get_group retrieves correct rows when grouping by columns containing tuple values
test_get_group_empty_bins: test get_group raises KeyError when requesting a group for an empty interval bin
test_iteration_over_groups: test iterating over groupby groups yields correct group keys and dataframes
test_multi_iter_frame: test multi-key groupby iteration over a DataFrame produces sorted groups with correct data
test_grouping_by_key_is_in_axis: test that Groupers specified by key are in-axis while level-based Groupers are not
test_groupby_any_with_timedelta: test groupby any aggregation on a column with Timedelta and NaT values
test_groupby_multiindex_tuple_column: test groupby with tuple keys on MultiIndex columns produces expected group keys
test_groupby_level_index_value_all_na: test groupby on MultiIndex with all NaN index values returns empty dataframe with correct index structure
